save_fsdp_model: save a PyTorch model to disk using FSDP state dict type with full, local, or sharded checkpoint formats
load_fsdp_model: load a PyTorch model from FSDP checkpoint files with full, local, or sharded state dict support
merge_fsdp_weights: merge sharded FSDP model checkpoints into a single safetensors or pytorch_model.bin file on CPU
save_fsdp_optimizer: save FSDP optimizer state to disk in full or sharded distributed checkpoint format
fsdp2_prepare_model: prepare a PyTorch model for FSDP2 by wrapping with fully_shard and handling meta device loading
